summary: terminal_full.py: CLI validates Quick Dev plan terminal state; args repository-root, plan-dir, optional out/slice; slices R0-R5 map tests/selectors and registered green commands; full runs all slice green plus quick-dev-suite and acceptance-suite; command registry commands constrained to repo cwd; result is non-authorizing terminal receipt with hashes, candidate binding, selectors, failures; full success predicate implementation-complete and publishes immutable completion receipt authorizing implementation-complete; slice success predicate slice-ready; candidate manifest hashes fixed production/consumer/validator/contract sources and rejects generated paths/escaping/missing sources; authority accepts implementation-authorized with matching authorization or implementation-complete with sole completion authorization; freeze context hash required; maintainer authorization receipt required and binds plan, contract, authority manifest, freeze; v2 also binds command registry and skill-input contract; knowledge failures require review except catalog_stale, which requires source_refresh; full requires R0-R5 non-authorizing terminal receipts and valid non-authorizing resume state; skill-input receipt must validate ready with no authorizations and target plan; full binds contract, registry, authority, context, freeze, latest skill-input receipt; output failures drive exit 1, pass exits 0; ambiguities: contract/registry reads occur before graceful missing-file handling; latest receipt selection uses mtime.
